integrity: The claim is supported by a symbolic winding argument and an independently replayed exact integer Smith-normal-form computation from the embedded verifier.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the canonical nine-vertex triangulation and simple edge cycles; does not classify longer representatives or all triangulations of the same manifold. Residual originality risk is an unindexed older computation of the exact missing-triangle classes.
title: Every missing triangle is an integral homology generator in Walkup's nine-vertex 3-dimensional Klein bottle
